item.title: Usino-Bundi-Gama secures road and services funding under 2026 Madang budget, says MP Kumura
item.description: Usino-Bundi-Gama MP, Vincent Kumura, says his district has secured funding for key road, education, health and basic services projects under the 2026 Madang Provincial Budget, following the passage of the K474 million financial plan in Madang today. Kumura confirmed that while the full district-by-district budget breakdown is yet to be released, priority projects for Usino-Bundi-Gama have already been captured in the provincial budget through District Development Authority resolutions. item.title: Over 500 blocks secured for major resettlement Plan
item.description: The Member for Moresby South and Minister for Foreign Affairs, Justin Tkatchenko, has announced over 500 land blocks have been secured to house families displaced by major infrastructure projects and urban renewals across the capital. Speaking at a press conference on Tuesday, January 27, 2025, the Minister outlined a strategic relocation plan that promises to transition residents from informal settlements into fully serviced, titled allotments.
